projects.name: Sustainable Firefighter Monitoring System (SFMS / SFMD)
projects.tagline: Keeping firefighters safe with real-time monitoring.
projects.description: SFMD (Smart Firefighter Monitoring Device) is a wearable IoT safety device that monitors firefighter movement, location, and environmental conditions in real-time and displays data on a live dashboard. Won 1st place in Department, 1st place in IEI technical paper presentation, and 2nd Prize in Hardware at A-HACKS 2026.

tech_stack.hardware: ESP32, DHT11, MQ-2, MPU6050, NEO-6M GPS, Push button, Buzzer, Battery

projects.achievement: 1st Place Dept, 1st Place IEI Paper Presentation, 2nd Prize Hardware Category A-HACKS 2026

projects.name: AutoExhaustFan
projects.tagline: Intelligent ventilation systems for safer spaces.
projects.description: AutoExhaustFan is an automated safety ventilation system that monitors air quality using an MQ-2 sensor and automatically triggers an exhaust fan via an Arduino UNO controller and 5V relay when harmful gas or smoke thresholds are breached.

projects.name: Solar Powered Dewatering System (SPDS)
projects.description: SPDS (SolarSquad) is a sustainable, smart mine dewatering system designed to replace inefficient diesel pumps. Features high-efficiency PV array, battery storage (BESS), smart pump VFD control, remote SCADA monitoring, automated sun tracking (+25% yield), and soil moisture sensor-driven automated pumping.

tech_stack.solar: High-Efficiency PV Array with Automated Sun Tracking
tech_stack.control: Smart VFD Pump Control, SCADA Remote Telemetry
